description: This file implements a Microsoft ADO database driver for the ADOdb database abstraction layer in PHP. It defines classes for managing database connections, executing queries, schema introspection, and handling record sets specifically for use with ADO via COM objects on Windows systems.

classes.name: ADODB_ado
classes.description: Handles database connections and operations specifically for the ADO driver on Windows platforms.

classes.name: ADORecordSet_ado
classes.description: Manages record set data retrieved via ADO COM objects, including fetching fields, iterating over records, and type conversions.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor for ADODB_ado initializing affected rows.

methods.name: _connect
methods.description: Establishes a connection to the database using OLEDB provider.

methods.name: MetaTables
methods.description: Retrieves list of database tables with filtering.

methods.name: MetaColumns
methods.description: Returns metadata for columns of a specified table.

methods.name: _query
methods.description: Executes SQL queries with optional parameters, handles both simple and parameterized queries.

methods.name: ErrorMsg
methods.description: Returns the last error message from ADO connection.

methods.name: ErrorNo
methods.description: Returns the last error number from ADO connection.
